text.tspan: A · How a gradient splits its step
the tiny model’s real update, and large random matrices through the real code (

A matrix’s singular values are the strengths of its main directions. A direction’s share of the step is its strength squared over the sum of all strengths squared. The raw gradient gives one direction most of the step; after Newton–Schulz every direction gets a similar share.
